offers.title: Birkly Hello Starter
offers.summary: Official free starter plugin — admin greeting widget and hello-world hooks.
offers.description: Get started extending Birkly with a minimal, verified plugin package. Includes plugin.json, entry hooks, and a sample admin panel snippet so you can learn the plugin lifecycle before building your own extensions.

offers.title: Birkly SEO Basics
offers.summary: Official SEO helpers — meta tags, sitemap, and Open Graph defaults.
offers.description: Improve discoverability with sensible SEO defaults: configurable meta tags, XML sitemap generation, and Open Graph fields integrated with your Birkly templates. Ideal for marketing sites that need structured metadata without a heavy SEO stack.

offers.title: Birkly Analytics Pro
offers.summary: Official analytics plugin — monthly subscription for traffic insights.
offers.description: Track page views, referrers, and conversion funnels. Subscription includes ongoing updates.

offers.title: Birkly Commerce
offers.summary: Official commerce plugin — payment providers, catalog, cart, checkout, orders, and fulfillment.
offers.description: Turn your Birkly site into a storefront. Commerce adds payment provider connections (Stripe and more), product catalog APIs, cart and checkout flows, order management, and fulfillment hooks. Other official plugins such as Events consume the payment shelf for paid tickets.

offers.title: Birkly Events
offers.summary: Official events plugin — free RSVP and paid tickets via commerce.
offers.description: Manage events with ticket types, capacity limits, and RSVP workflows. Free events confirm instantly; paid tickets route through Commerce when installed. Includes automation triggers for registrations and capacity alerts.

offers.title: Birkly Automation
offers.summary: Official workflow automation — triggers, conditions, and actions.
offers.description: Build lightweight workflows without leaving Birkly. Connect triggers (content changes, commerce events, webhooks) to conditions and actions such as notifications, field updates, and plugin hooks.

offers.title: Birkly User Management
offers.summary: Official user management — registration, authentication, permissions, and tiers.
offers.description: Add front-of-site registration, login, permission tiers, and member-only content patterns. Integrates with Birkly roles and template functions for gated areas and commerce customer accounts.
